reason: The stop is a server-side rejection of the archive tag push to origin, with no reason text after "(failed)". The remote branch is at the teardown commit and the local tag exists, so the cause is not a missing commit or an unreachable remote. Whether a plain re-launch settles it depends on whether the rejection is a ruleset on archive tags or a race with the detached fabric push (pid 1999746); that needs a judgment on the remote side that I cannot make from the files and read-only commands. See case-brief.md in this directory for the facts and the hypothesis.
